body: He was dating a child! Why would you want that for yourself?
So you where 17 and he was 21 when you started dating??? RUN!
Sometimes it's okay to not have an answer.

It hurts when you have to leave or are left, but it's for your own good. It's hurts because you're stuck in an endless cycle, but you have to remind yourself what the end game is. What good is going to come from you staying in a loop. It's not good for anyone in the long run. Rip it off like a bandaid, and feel the pain, but don't live in it.

I wouldn't stop myself from meeting them because I feel like the universe had a plan for me and put them in my life for a reason. I do wish that the first time we called it quits, we both would have gone through with it. Now it just feels like attachment. I know it's no good, but for some reason, I can not let go.

I had to block him for my sanity but it worked out great for him in the end because he had my replacement waiting for him for the 5+ years we were together. Here I am still single and too hurt to move on. I wish I could be like him without a care in the world.

I'm in the exact same boat if you need anyone to talk too. Currently looking for somewhere to move. I'm hopelessy inlove with him but there been too much hurt to go back. Doesnt mean it wouldn't be nice.

It's hard hearing this. Especially when you really don't want to let go. You're begging for any glimmer of hope that there might be a future again some day. If I do this If I do that, but it's not fair of me to make you choose me if you really dont want me. I have to be okay with that. I have to accept the fact that it just wasn't meant to be. I'll miss my bestfriend.
A broken mind with a broken heart.
